name: Hentai Girls - Neko Pastry
source:
Strawberry and Cupcake are two adorable Neko girls that are working in a little pastry shop.
They love to show up everyday dressed in cute outfits, with matching collars and gloves, and wearing pretty makeup.
Everywhere they go, the bells around their necks ring in the most delightful way.
So kawaii!
All they have to do during the day is to be polite and serve each client with a big smile on their faces.
The customers are very important for the business, so the two of them have to work hard to make a good impression and to sell as many cakes as possible.
Their sweets are the most famous in town ... Is it because of the taste or because of the girls? We would never know.
Strawberry and Cupcake were both rescued from a kitty shelter a time ago.
The Master took pity on them and decided to take both into his care.
He offered them a job, food and shelter.
But most important, a lovely place where they could feel safe.
From that moment, they are very grateful and are doing everything they can to thank their Master.
On a few occasions, however, they managed to upset the Master, and they were punished accordingly. Meow!

他们喜欢每天穿着可爱的衣服、搭配相配的衣领和手套，化着漂亮的妆容出现。

顾客对于生意来说非常重要，所以他们两个必须努力给人留下好印象，并尽可能多地卖出蛋糕。
他们的甜品是城里最有名的……是因为味道还是因为女孩子？我们永远不会知道。

但最重要的是，一个让他们感到安全的可爱地方。
从那一刻起，他们就非常感恩，并尽一切努力来感谢他们的师父。
然而，有几次，他们惹恼了主人，并受到了相应的惩罚。喵！
